tools.description: Run one read-only aggregation pipeline on a MongoDB collection and get documents as relaxed Extended JSON with every personal value pseudonymized. Writes ($out, $merge), server-side JavaScript and admin stages are refused; fields computed by the pipeline are pseudonymized unless their lineage is proven clear. Same limits as find.

cell_offset.description: Characters to skip at the start of every text value before the 500-character cap; repeat a request with the offset given in a truncation to read the rest of a long value

collection.description: Collection or view the pipeline starts from, as returned by list_tables

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections (engine mongodb)

database.description: Database to read; required when the connection declares no default database; names come from list_databases

let.description: Variables of the pipeline in Extended JSON

max_bytes.description: Maximum size of the returned documents in bytes (default 16384, maximum 65536)

pipeline.description: Aggregation pipeline in Extended JSON: an array of read stages, for example [{"$match": {"status": "paid"}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$status", "n": {"$sum": 1}}}]

timeout_ms.description: Server time limit in milliseconds (default 10000, maximum 60000)

tools.name: aggregate

tools.description: Describe one table: columns and types, primary key, foreign keys in both directions, indexes, estimated rows, and which columns will be pseudonymized and as which kind.

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections

database.description: Database of the same server to use instead of the connection's default database; names come from list_databases

tools.name: describe_table

tools.description: Show the execution plan of one read-only SQL statement (EXPLAIN without ANALYZE, FORMAT TEXT, JSON or YAML). Literals in the plan are pseudonymized.

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections

database.description: Database of the same server to use instead of the connection's default database; names come from list_databases

sql.description: One read-only SQL statement to explain

tools.name: explain

tools.description: Run one find on a MongoDB collection and get documents as relaxed Extended JSON with every personal value pseudonymized. filter, projection and sort are Extended JSON objects; only read query operators are accepted. Defaults: 50 documents, 16 KB, 10 s; maxima 500 documents, 64 KB, 60 s (max_rows, max_bytes, timeout_ms). Text values are cut at 500 characters (read the rest with cell_offset) and arrays at 100 items.

cell_offset.description: Characters to skip at the start of every text value before the 500-character cap; repeat a request with the offset given in a truncation to read the rest of a long value

collection.description: Collection or view name, as returned by list_tables

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections (engine mongodb)

database.description: Database to read; required when the connection declares no default database; names come from list_databases

filter.description: Query filter in Extended JSON, for example {"status": "paid", "_id": {"$oid": "..."}}

hint.description: Index name or key pattern to use

limit.description: Maximum documents to read, capped at max_rows

max_bytes.description: Maximum size of the returned documents in bytes (default 16384, maximum 65536)

projection.description: Projection in Extended JSON, for example {"status": 1}

skip.description: Documents to skip; prefer a keyset filter on _id

sort.description: Sort in Extended JSON, for example {"_id": 1}

timeout_ms.description: Server time limit in milliseconds (default 10000, maximum 60000)

tools.name: find

tools.description: List the PostgreSQL connections of the developer's connection file and, as a fallback, of the DBeaver workspace, with source (file or dbeaver), status (available, unavailable, unsupported), reason and connection type (dev, test, prod). Never returns hosts or credentials.
tools.name: list_connections

tools.description: List the databases of the server behind one connection, with the connection's default database (the one the connection points at). Pass a name as the database argument of query, explain, search_schema, list_tables or describe_table to use it.

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections

tools.name: list_databases

tools.description: List tables and views of a connection, one compact line each with kind, estimated rows and column count. Paginated with limit.

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections

database.description: Database of the same server to use instead of the connection's default database; names come from list_databases

limit.description: Maximum number of tables returned (default 100, maximum 500)

name_like.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against table names

offset.description: Number of tables to skip, for pagination

tools.name: list_tables

tools.description: Run one read-only SQL statement and get rows with every personal value pseudonymized. Defaults: 50 rows, 16 KB, 10 s; maxima 500 rows, 64 KB, 60 s (max_rows, max_bytes, timeout_ms). Text cells are cut at 500 characters; read the rest with cell_offset. Sorting, ranges, LIKE, length and hashing act on real values.

cell_offset.description: Characters to skip at the start of every text cell before the 500-character cap; repeat a query with the offset given in a cell truncation to read the rest of a long value

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections

database.description: Database of the same server to use instead of the connection's default database; names come from list_databases

max_bytes.description: Maximum size of the returned rows in bytes (default 16384, maximum 65536)

tools.name: query

tools.description: Find tables and columns whose name matches a pattern (case-insensitive) in one connection. Use it to locate where data lives before writing SQL.

connection.description: Connection name as returned by list_connections

database.description: Database of the same server to use instead of the connection's default database; names come from list_databases

pattern.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against table and column names

tools.name: search_schema

tools.description: Return the live limits, the pseudonym kinds that can or cannot be reused in filters, the operations that act on real values, and the known limitations.
tools.name: server_info
